title: Proper finiteness for a single locally closed all-continuous lisse piece
statement: Fix a prime ell and a field k of positive prime characteristic different from ell, and a proper k-morphism p:X to Y between separated finite-type k-schemes [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let B be the condensed ring of all continuous maps to the topological algebraic closure PadicAlgCl ell, with pulled-back ring B_T on T. Let v:V to X be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], let t:S to V be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and assume S reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. If L is a lisse B_S-module [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module], then every integer-degree cohomology module of Rp_*(v_! t_* L)[0] has finite constant local models on a finite constructible stratification of Y [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model]. Here v_! is the ordinary module-object extension by zero [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek], t_* is the ordinary module-object direct image [def-sfb-module-lower-star], and Rp_* is the total right derived module-object pushforward [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. The notation means Rp_*((v_! t_* L)[0]); no finite-subextension-valued restriction on B is imposed. Empty S, zero L and rank zero are included.

source.place: Proper direct image paragraph, specialized to a locally closed lisse generator; the compact-monodromy, lattice and finite-model comparison expansion is the original single proof step of det-sf-comp-continuous-algcl-heart-finiteness (Sheaf.Paper.ContinuousAlgClProperHeartFiniteness, original theorem docstring).

proof.text: Give S the induced finite-type separated k-scheme structure. On a finite normal refinement of S, a lisse all-continuous coefficient module gives finite-dimensional continuous monodromy of a profinite fundamental group. Compact-matrix coefficient descent gives a finite intermediate extension E of Q_ell containing all matrix entries. Choose an invariant integral lattice, descend the representation to E and extend it by zero along the given locally closed immersion. Localization and noetherian induction handle the refinement and its closed complement. This step is only a stratum calculation, not the finite-filtration devissage for arbitrary constructible input.

source.place: Proper direct image paragraph, specialized to a locally closed lisse generator; the compact-monodromy, lattice and finite-model comparison expansion is the original single proof step of det-sf-comp-continuous-algcl-heart-finiteness (Sheaf.Paper.ContinuousAlgClProperHeartFiniteness, original theorem docstring).

proof.text: For the finite E piece use properHeart_constructible_cohomology, and for its integral lattice use the finite torsion reductions, their common proper cohomological bound and the Milnor sequence. On an adapted target stratum obtain a bounded finite-projective cochain model of the integral proper image. This bound and finite generation permit the coefficient comparison to be computed termwise with finite matrices. After inverting ell and extending these matrices to B=C(-,PadicAlgCl ell), they compute the actual B-coefficient proper image of the extended lisse piece. Descend the resulting finite constant local models on a finite target stratification. This comparison is the remaining content of the lemma: it does not invoke the existing all-continuous scalar comparison, whose proof in turn assumes the parent theorem. In particular it does not identify B with the finite-subextension-valued coefficient ring.

proof.text: Left t-exactness of the derived pushforward makes the negative cohomology zero. Zero modules and empty strata have rank-zero finite constant models. Combining this with the calculation in nonnegative degrees proves the assertion for every integer n.

theorem continuousAlgCl_proper_lisse_stratum
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p]
    (V S : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion v]
    (t : S ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion t] [IsReduced S]
    (L : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) S))
    (hL : IsLisseCoefficientModule (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) L) :
    ∀ n : ℤ, IsConstantModelConstructible
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) Y
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
        ((lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((openImmersionLowerShriek (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) v).obj
              ((lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) t).obj L)))))
